{{Orphan|date=June 2019}}


In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''Tango bundle''' is one of the indecomposable [[vector bundle]]s of rank ''n''&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;1 constructed on ''n''-dimensional projective space ''P''<sup>''n''</sup> by {{harvtxt|Tango|1976}}
